test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two positions of the same cubical block are shown. When one of the faces W is at the top, which face will be at the bottom?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7509ceda16f22fda5f9c7c221f54f4824af3848854e57df79e08def355ac1425.png]
solution:
Explanation:

In the given figure we can see two positions of a cube which shows that X is adjacent to A, B, Y, and Z which means we can see all four adjacent sides of X. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39b724df07f1ed0c085d7d0355a453da96c82c5d1353f736d976021d3dc2ea4f.png] 

Since there are only 6 sides and we know 5 of them it is very easy to calculate that the bottom face is W which means **W is opposite to X.**

If W is on the top then it is obvious that **the face on the bottom will be X.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3.**
